newsitem.title: USA: US late prods mixed in ACCESS trade after APIs.
newsitem.headline: US late prods mixed in ACCESS trade after APIs.

text.p: U.S. spot distillate prices jumped a half cent tracking after-hours ACCESS trade, with gasoline slipping 0.30 cent following API data showing an unexpected draw on distillates but a solid gain in gasoline inventories, traders said.
Almost simultaneously with release of the data, traders shifted their focus to news of a fire at Shell Oil Co's 268,000 barrel per day refinery in Wood River, Illinois.
Differentials on Gulf conventional unleaded gasoline briefly firmed to about 3.0 cents above December futures on the refinery news.

But they retreated to near earlier levels of 1.75 cents over the print after authorities confirmed the fire had been put out and Shell reported it would trim crude runs only "minimally" as a result of the two hour blaze.
Shell said the fire broke out in a gas plant furnace and that an alkylation unit was also taken off line but was undamaged in the fire, which was extinguished at 1530 CST.
It predicted the 20,000 bpd alkylation unit would return to service Wednesday.
